Hello! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant living on this computer. I've got your setup: I'm here for Professor Alvarez (CSE455, UW) and for Diego, one of their graduate students — calendar and messages, plus whatever else you need.

Also, in case you didn't see it on the machine's screen: from a phone or computer on this network you can open the web app at https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca), and I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts — each needs its own phone number and a QR scan from you. I can also sign up for accounts on websites myself, schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two small things: how would you like me to be addressed (name is **alvarez-agent** unless you want another), and should I use neuter forms for myself, or something else? What would you like to start with?

Hi Diego — I'm **diego-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer (I'm neither male nor female — neuter/plural forms for me). Nice to meet you.

What I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (write and call me there), plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read the setup: your working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and your calendar is in `files/CALENDAR.md` — I'll keep it updated and log every change. I know Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) as a contact.

Two small notes: your name and gender are set (Diego, root); I'll tell you the moment Professor Alvarez writes. What would you like to start with?

On it: I've written to Diego asking him to put **Wednesday 18 Nov, 10:00–10:30** on his calendar, and mentioned the CSE451 lecture being cancelled so he doesn't skip it as a clash. I've also set myself a reminder for that slot in your name.

I'll tell you the moment he confirms — or if he offers a different time.
